goal: Tell whether the information need of the CHAOSS metrics model Community Governed AI Use in Open Communities is answered for the UOR Foundation community.

app.name: chaoss-community-governed-ai-use-in-open-communities
app.title: Community Governed AI Use in Open Communities indicator
app.purpose: The ISO/IEC 15939 indicator of the CHAOSS metrics model Community Governed AI Use in Open Communities: from how many of its 5 metrics have an admitted observation and how many were refused, tell whether its information need is answered, partly answered, unmeasured or an open claim.

fields.name: admitted
fields.means: how many of the model's 5 metrics have an observation uor-observation-admission permitted: Policy Specificity; Policy Change; Use Composition; Use Compliance; Misuse

fields.name: refused
fields.means: how many of them had their observation refused

meanings.open: a base measure was refused, so the information need stays an open claim
meanings.complete: every one of the 5 metrics has an admitted observation, so the information need is answered
meanings.unmeasured: no base measure has an admitted observation yet
meanings.partial: some base measures have admitted observations and none was refused

rules.why: AGENTS.md R2: a refused observation is measured and reported, never restated as an answer; CC-03 carries an unmatched member the same way

ISO/IEC 15939 indicator: every base measure of wg-ai-alignment@0d0f78655aab6417293aaefd85e08ecc72ddabfa:metrics/ai-alignment-community-governed-use/metric-model-ai-alignment-community-governed-use.md (sha256:b3e7273720f3972f52ad54d0da87cffb2783d4587f67af0c9400c23c2d167cf3) has an admitted measurement
ISO/IEC 15939: an indicator with no base measure measured answers no information need

app.otherwiseWhy: some base measures are admitted, none refused and some not yet observed

properties.why: an information need with a refused base measure is never answered complete
an information need is answered complete only when every base measure is admitted
every base measure admitted and none refused answers the information need
an admitted base measure is never reported unmeasured

stakeholders.name: Community and Outreach Committee
stakeholders.text: Reads the CHAOSS metrics models of the Foundation's community and needs every number behind them validated.

components.name: CHAOSS observation admission
components.text: The uor-observation-admission app, whose permitted observations are the indicator's admitted count.
